name: Sandra Gómez López - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Spain – EGF/2026/002 ES/Galicia automotive ancillary
part_text:
The European Parliament approves giving Spain 2,725,100 euros from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund. The money helps 400 workers in Galicia who lost jobs at car parts suppliers. It pays for job advice, training in digital and industrial skills, help finding work, and small payments for travel, care costs and taking part. The fund covers 85 percent of the 3,206,000 euro total cost. The report also asks for better awareness of the fund and closer monitoring of job losses in the car industry across Europe.

- Spain receives 2.7 million euros to retrain and place 400 dismissed Galicia car parts workers.
- Affected: 671 workers were dismissed; 400 are expected to join the support measures.
- Next: the decision is signed and published, then Spain runs the measures for up to 24 months.
